title: Cancelling a Flexible Booking
text: A flexible booking that is confirmed can be cancelled. If check-in is 3 or more days away the guest gets a full refund. If check-in is 1 or 2 days away the guest gets 50 percent of the amount paid. On the check-in day or later there is no refund.

title: Non-Refundable Rates
text: A non-refundable booking gets no refund when the guest cancels, whatever the date. The only exception is when the hotel cancels the booking.

title: Stays Already Started
text: A booking that is already checked in, completed or cancelled cannot be cancelled again and gets no refund.

title: When the Hotel Cancels
text: If the hotel cancels a booking, the guest gets a full refund of the amount paid, even on a non-refundable rate.

title: Who Approves a Refund
text: Refunds of 5000 rupees or less are approved automatically. Refunds above 5000 and up to 25000 rupees need a reviewer. Refunds above 25000 rupees need a senior reviewer. Only active staff can approve.

title: When the Money Comes Back
text: An approved refund goes back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 working days.

title: Check-In and Check-Out Times
text: Check-in starts at 2 pm and check-out is at 11 am. Early check-in depends on the hotel and is not guaranteed.

title: Guest Privacy
text: Support staff never share one guest's booking details with another guest. Booking details are shown only to the guest who owns the booking.
